sentence: On the balanced frame the frozen ViT-B fires once decoupled in 7 of 10 seeds. That frame's matched flat control does not fire once decoupled, so this is not a false alarm: ViT-B shows hub structure under that grouping that the frame of record does not resolve; and a cloud organized under one frame fires under the other even once decoupled, so frames are not interchangeable.
